original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳国家体育管理局局长被停职，Emmanuel Sarpong接任
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳总统签署日期为2026年10月1日的信函，指示国家体育管理局局长Yaw Ampofo Ankrah立即停职，由Emmanuel Sarpong教授接任该机构负责人。此次人事变动与世界杯签证争议相关。目前该消息为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 加纳总统指示国家体育管理局局长Yaw Ampofo Ankrah立即停职
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In a letter dated October 1, 2026, and signed by the Secretary to the President, Calitus Mahama, the President directed that Mr Ampofo Ankrah be suspended from his duties with immediate effect.

key_facts.fact: Emmanuel Sarpong教授接任国家体育管理局负责人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Prof. Emmanuel Sarpong replaces Yaw Ampofo Ankrah as National Sports Authority boss

key_facts.fact: 此次停职与世界杯签证争议相关
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Yaw Ampofo Ankrah suspended as NSA Director-General amid World Cup visa controversy
